gen.orderNote: Follow the definition order from full interval to result.

steps.label: Divide the sorted interval in half
steps.quote: Search a sorted array by repeatedly dividing the search interval in half.

steps.label: Begin with the whole array interval
steps.quote: Begin with an interval covering the whole array.

steps.label: Narrow to the lower half
steps.quote: If the value of the search key is less than the item in the middle of the interval, narrow the interval to the lower half.

steps.label: Narrow to the upper half
steps.quote: Otherwise narrow it to the upper half.

steps.label: Check until found or interval empty
steps.quote: Repeatedly check until the value is found or the interval is empty.
